system.description:
7th Level Clan Feature

[Side Branch]

The iconic fighting style of the Hyuga, doesn’t stop at just your martial arts, but in all forms of chakra-based warfare. When you cast a Jutsu that deals necrotic damage or has the Medical keyword, you manifest the mythical Eight Trigrams sigil as part of its casting. Once per casting, one of the affected creatures that would attempt to cast a jutsu that requires chakra molding (CM) must make a Constitution saving throw vs your highest save DC. On a failure, they trigger the seal you placed as they gain 3 ranks of Network Distortion.
